title: A Joomla import that cannot install Claude Cowork keeps each road's evidence and names the host limit (memory, upload size) instead of a bare install_failed
steps: S1: Run the real joomla.installCowork (packages/site/tracy-add-site/src/host/joomla.ts) with fetch mocked: phpinfo shows memory_limit 128M, upload_max_filesize 8M, post_max_size 8M; the URL install POST answers 500; the package is about 60 MB.
S2: Same, but the URL install POST answers 500 with PHP's 'Allowed memory size of … bytes exhausted' in its body.
S3: Same as S1, but phpinfo shows no limits and the upload answers 200 with nothing installed.
S4: The URL install POST answers 500 and the upload installs the component.
S5: Sanitize an install diagnostic with tracy-web importDiagnostic and render it with signalText.

S6: Run installCowork with a package 8 KB under an 8M post_max_size; with a URL 500 whose single 100 KB chunk starts with the memory error; with a URL memory error then a failed package download; with a 403 on the upload POST then a URL 500 (the upload road goes first since #1568).
expect: S1: reason upload_too_large; no upload POST is sent; diagnostic.roads.url_install.post_status is 500 and roads.upload_install.cause is over_limit; php_limits and package_bytes are kept.
S2: reason site_resource_limit with check memory_exhausted; no page text is kept in the diagnostic.
S3: the upload is sent and the result is install_failed, its diagnostic carrying both roads.
S5: only known road names, causes and limit names survive; the alert shows a Roads line and a Sizes line.

S6: a package 8 KB under an 8M post_max_size is still uploaded; a 100 KB first chunk starting with the memory error is still read; a failed download after a URL memory error is site_resource_limit; a 403 on the upload then a URL 500 keeps both roads, the limits and the 403.

selectors.code: joomla.installCowork roads/readPhpInfo/uploadBlockedBy, diagnostic.mjs DIAGNOSTIC_ROADS, apps/tracy-web/src/lib/import-diagnostic.js, ops-signal.js installRoads

evidence: Joomla 6.1.3 with memory_limit 128M and upload/post limits 8M, ~60 MB package (19/10/2026): the URL install POST died with a 500 (memory exhausted), the upload came back 200 with nothing installed, and the diagnostic kept only the later 200
fence: installCowork's per-road evidence and the phpinfo limit check before the upload road

tests: a URL 500 then a package over the known upload limits is upload_too_large, the 500 kept
a POST whose answer carries PHP memory exhaustion is site_resource_limit
limits phpinfo does not show change nothing: the upload is sent and its failure is install_failed
an upload that lands is a success, and the URL road that would die is never asked
a package under the known limits still goes over the upload road
phpinfo limits are read as PHP reads them: K, M, G, -1, and unknown when missing
an install stopped by a host limit names the limit, not "install it yourself"
a package just under post_max_size is still sent: the envelope counted is the real one
PHP's memory error at the head of a large first chunk is still read
a package that cannot be downloaded after a URL memory error is site_resource_limit
a 403 on the upload then a URL 500 keeps both roads, the PHP limits and the 403
